theorem_statement: Every relay-bearing frontier cycle has an order-four setwise stabilizer of one uniform isomorphism type. The audit determines whether that subgroup is V4 or C4 and whether it equals or is conjugate to the native chamber V4.

interpretation.earned: The near-impostor frontier has a homogeneous residual symmetry of order four.
interpretation.comparison: Registered closure has stabilizer D10 of order 20. The frontier retains only the classified order-four subgroup while carrying its external answering relay.
